regime_context: The Hong Kong detector shows a narrowing eligible set (7 of 17 themes above the absolute-trend gate, 41% breadth) with no one-narrative dominance and only 48% absorption — leadership is thin and contested rather than concentrated. The single validated edge on this market's history is drawdown avoidance via the trend gate (gate_helps=true), while cross-sectional momentum carries no return-forecast edge; the macro backdrop is dominated by AI-tech headlines with a very high unscheduled-surprise share (0.97), signalling headline-driven chop rather than a clean thematic regime. No theme has a scorable ETF proxy except the two China-tech laggards tracked by 3033.HK, yielding no cleanly gradeable directional theses from this state.
emerging_watch: I am watching whether the eligible set widens back above ~50% breadth (a confirmed re-broadening of participation) before any 'overweight the defensive staples' bias hardens; the detector's eligible breadth is currently narrowing at 0.41, and if it stays below half with absorption under 0.5, the defensive-in-eligible lean stays low-conviction at best. I would retire this watch either when eligible breadth closes above 0.5 for two consecutive reads (broadening confirmed) or when absorption rises above ~0.8 (a dominant narrative forms), whichever comes first.

theses.subject: High-Dividend Blue Chips
theses.thesis: Among the eligible (above trend-gate) themes, High-Dividend Blue Chips has the strongest staying-power profile: eligibility is true, durability_bar is the highest in the eligible set (0.81), breadth is a full 1.0 (all constituents participating), and hurst_tag is 'trend'. This is not a momentum argument — the score is only mid-table at 0.542 — but a 'the trend discipline would have kept you in this name with reduced drawdown' argument, which is the one validated edge. With no one-narrative regime and 97% unscheduled headline risk, an income/defensive theme with full participation is the most conservative eligible expression of the detector's discipline.
theses.dissent: High-dividend names in Hong Kong are heavily rate-sensitive; if global yields or HK interbank rates stay elevated, dividend yield compression is a headwind the trend-gate cannot see, and the theme's steady grind can stall even while staying above its trend line.
